inventive_nucleus: A thin, conductive mesh is embedded within the electrode gel to maintain its structural integrity and prevent degradation.
structure: The conductive mesh is embedded within the electrode gel, which is then applied to the patient's skin.
interaction: The conductive mesh interacts with the electrode gel to maintain its structural integrity.
operating_condition: When the electrode gel is exposed to environmental stressors.
failure_containment: The conductive mesh prevents the formation of air pockets and subsequent degradation of the gel.

inventive_nucleus: A real-time, low-power temperature sensor is implemented to monitor the electrode gel's temperature and adjust the adaptive signal quality gating algorithm accordingly.
structure: The temperature sensor is integrated into the ECG monitor, which is then applied to the patient's skin.
interaction: The temperature sensor interacts with the ECG monitor to adjust the signal quality gating algorithm.
operating_condition: When the electrode gel is exposed to environmental stressors.
failure_containment: The temperature sensor detects potential degradation and adjusts the algorithm accordingly.

inventive_nucleus: A self-healing electrode gel is developed that can repair itself when degraded, reducing electrode-skin impedance and improving ECG signal quality.
structure: The self-healing electrode gel is applied to the patient's skin, which is then monitored by the ECG monitor.
interaction: The self-healing electrode gel interacts with the patient's skin to repair itself.
operating_condition: When the electrode gel is exposed to environmental stressors.
failure_containment: The self-healing gel restores its original properties, reducing electrode-skin impedance.
